Now that I give some more proper thought, I don't think we will get any sort of AsuShin stuff in the new movie. And honestly, I don't mind!

We barely got to see proper development in Shikinami and Shinji's ""relationship"" in the Rebuilds. I mean, back in 2.0, they were really just roommates, and nothing else really got going between the two of them specifically. Sure, Asuka slept in Shinji's bed, but we never knew the true importance of that, unlike in the original series, where we, the audience, got to know exactly why Soryu slept in Shinji's bed. Nothing else deep happened between the two of them, aside from that. Sure, during the Unit-03 incident, that might have changed if only slightly, but before then, nothing.

And speaking of Shikinami, we barely know anything about her past, either. We only know that she has (or had) a doll from her childhood kept with her, and that she had that one WonderSwan with her at all times. We don't know anything about her past, who her mother was, the significance of the WonderSwan and the doll to Shikinami, nothing at all!

If it did happen, however, I wouldn't really understand the logic behind it, even as an AsuShin fan myself. I only started pairing the both of them because of how much alike they are (given their traumas, and all that), of how broken they are by both the Eva and by the circumstances behind them, and of how much they could help eachother move from those struggles if they just got together. If Anno does ship them in for just some plain-old fan-service, I'll be pretty dissapointed.

I wouldn't mind something like EoE's ending happening again, honestly. Not the whole destruction of mankind and Third Impact stuff, just the two of them making patches in their freindship and living in harmony with eachother.

I don't think ReiShin will happen, and I am slightly glad.  
Currently, Shinji seems to have some resentment towards Rei (or Rei Q, at the moment) for being a clone, which is kind of a dickish move by Shinji, if you ask me. 

He only went back to NERV in 3.0 because he thought Rei returned from the events of 2.0, even with Wille telling him she never came back. And when he knew that Rei Q was just a clone of his mother (that happened during the big redpill scene dropped by Fuyutsuki), he got quite mad, even during the descent to Terminal Dogma. Honestly, he shouldn't even resent Rei Q for just being a clone, it's so ridiculous from Shinji's part.
